title: ADIPEC 2026
description: ADIPEC 2026 is a major global energy gathering in Abu Dhabi combining strategic leadership, technical engineering, energy security, upstream, gas and LNG, downstream, AI and digital technology, finance, infrastructure and lower-carbon energy systems.

program.overview: ADIPEC 2026 publishes 13 conference programmes and more than 380 sessions across strategic and technical conferences. The technical conference includes SPE and downstream programmes, with more than 190 technical sessions and over 1,100 expert speakers.

registration_fees.notes: Standard price shown by the official conference site.
Standard price shown by the official conference site.

community.overview: ADIPEC connects energy leaders, engineers, operators, investors, policymakers and technology providers across the global energy value chain.

title: Offshore Technology Conference (OTC) 2027
description: OTC 2027 brings the global offshore energy community to Houston for technologies and technical knowledge spanning offshore oil and gas, offshore wind, carbon management, hydrogen, marine systems and emerging energy solutions.

program.overview: OTC 2027 publishes a comprehensive technical programme with peer-reviewed papers, expert presentations, panels, case studies and interactive sessions focused on offshore operations, engineering, digital transformation, sustainability and energy innovation.

community.overview: OTC connects engineers, geoscientists, operators, service companies, researchers, innovators and decision-makers across offshore energy.

title: International Petroleum Technology Conference (IPTC) 2027
organizer: IPTC (AAPG, EAGE, SEG & SPE), hosted by PTTEP
description: IPTC 2027 is the 18th International Petroleum Technology Conference in Bangkok, integrating geoscience, reservoir engineering, drilling, production, facilities, gas, digitalisation and AI, decarbonisation and future-energy disciplines.

cfp.submission_guidelines: The official Call for Papers is closed. Paper proposals used a maximum 450-word abstract structured around objective/scope, methods, results/conclusions and novel/additive information.

program.overview: IPTC 2027 covers the upstream value chain from exploration and reservoir development through drilling, production, facilities, gas processing, digitalisation, AI, decarbonisation and future energy.

title: MWC Barcelona 2027
description: MWC Barcelona 2027 is GSMA's flagship connectivity and technology event, bringing together telecoms, AI, cloud, devices, enterprise technology and adjacent industries at Fira Gran Via in Barcelona.

cfp.submission_guidelines: MWC27 states that speaker submissions close on 5 November 2026 at 23:00 CET.

program.overview: MWC27's thought-leadership programme is organised around six published themes.

venueInfo.address: Av. Joan Carles I, 64, L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Barcelona, Spain

community.overview: MWC Barcelona convenes the global connectivity ecosystem across operators, technology companies, startups, policymakers, investors and enterprise leaders.

title: Microsoft Ignite 2026
description: Microsoft Ignite 2026 is Microsoft's major AI, cloud and technology learning event for business leaders, security leaders, IT professionals, developers and partners, with an in-person San Francisco programme and digital experience.

program.overview: Ignite combines product and roadmap sessions, practical technical learning, hands-on labs, certifications, expert guidance and community collaboration across Microsoft's AI and cloud ecosystem.

community.overview: Microsoft Ignite connects business leaders, security leaders, IT professionals, developers, partners and Microsoft experts.

title: AWS re:Invent 2026
description: AWS re:Invent 2026 is a five-day cloud and AI conference in Las Vegas with thousands of sessions, hands-on workshops, labs, technical deep dives, keynotes and direct access to AWS experts and engineers.

program.overview: The official programme lists more than 2,200 sessions across cloud, AI, security, migration, developer productivity, architecture and hands-on technical learning.

registration_fees.notes: Official full price after the early-bird period.

venueInfo.accommodation: Conference content runs across Caesars Forum, Caesars Palace, Encore, MGM Grand, The Venetian and Wynn.

community.overview: re:Invent brings together cloud practitioners, security professionals, developers, architects and business decision-makers from across industries.

title: GITEX GLOBAL 2026
organizer: Dubai World Trade Centre / GITEX GLOBAL
description: GITEX GLOBAL 2026 moves to Expo City Dubai for a five-day technology and AI event spanning conferences, workshops, exhibitions, networking and next-generation business partnerships.

program.overview: The 2026 event includes the GITEX Summit on 7 December followed by the GITEX GLOBAL Expo from 8–11 December, with conference content across AI, cybersecurity, mobility, sustainable technology and the intelligent economy.

community.overview: GITEX connects technology creators, investors, startups, enterprises, government leaders and technology professionals from around the world.

title: BIO International Convention 2027
description: BIO International Convention 2027 returns to Philadelphia and brings together the global biotechnology ecosystem across biopharma, startups, academia, government, research, business development and investment.

program.overview: BIO's convention format combines an industry programme, company presentations, BIO Partnering, exhibition activity, sponsorship and networking across the biotechnology ecosystem.

community.overview: BIO states that the convention represents the full biotechnology ecosystem and connects roughly 20,000 industry leaders from around the world.

title: 25th WPC Energy Congress 2026
description: The 25th WPC Energy Congress in Riyadh brings together global energy leaders, scientists, policymakers, operators and innovators under the theme Pathways to an Energy Future for All, covering energy security, petroleum, gas, carbon management, technology, investment and the energy transition.

program.overview: The official Congress programme runs 11–15 October 2026 and combines ministerial and strategic sessions, a peer-reviewed technical programme, synergy and special programmes, exhibition activity and networking. The technical programme spans five thematic blocks and 31 specialised forums.
